overview: The Medford Traffic Commission met to consider residential parking variance requests and street parking restriction updates. The commission approved parking variances for residents on Harvard Street and Marshall Street, as well as new parking regulations on Alfred Street.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Resident Permit Parking Variance - 164 Harvard Street
items.summary: Approved a resident permit parking variance on Wareham Street for an occupant of 164 Harvard Street.

items.title: Alfred Street Parking Regulations
items.summary: Approved designated business-adjacent areas on Alfred Street to be two-hour parking from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. except by permit, and permit parking only from 8:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m.

items.title: Marshall Street Parking Variance and Visitor Passes
items.summary: Approved a parking variance and visitor passes on Marshall Street for a Winter Street resident.
